caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a metal spur with a large, multi-pointed rowel. The spur consists of a U-shaped yoke with rectangular slots on each end and an attached figure-eight shaped heel band, rendered in shades of gray and black to simulate the appearance of aged or tarnished metal. A short, twisted chain is attached to one side of the heel band, shown in a loose, curving arrangement. Below the main image is a smaller, separate segment, likely a detailed view of part of the spur, also rendered in gray and black tones. The background is plain and off-white, and the text "ACTUAL SIZE" appears in capital letters below the main object. In the bottom right corner, the name “W.J. Goodacre” is signed.
title: Spur
